item.title: fix(approvals): prevent cross-channel exec approval leak (#122517)
item.summary: fix(approvals): prevent cross-channel exec approval leak (#122517) Reject unbound foreign-channel fallback at shared approval-account selection while preserving recorded bindings and explicit forwarding targets. Cover Telegram and Matrix routing contracts. Co-authored-by: vatsalgargg Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
